title: Future Forms 2026 poster
task: Create an original, premium A4 portrait conference poster in CorelDRAW X7 using only editable vector shapes and artistic text. The design should feel like a contemporary international design-festival identity: bold typographic hierarchy, intentional asymmetry, generous negative space, a geometric orbital focal point, and production-clean alignment.

desired_output.composition: Small metadata header at top, oversized FUTURE/FORMS title in the upper-left, compact 26 edition badge at upper-right, orbital focal system in the lower-right, dot matrix and event details balancing the lower-left, and a quiet footer.
desired_output.hierarchy: FORMS is the strongest element, FUTURE is secondary, the orbital motif is the visual anchor, and metadata remains clearly subordinate.
desired_output.finish: No accidental clipping, collisions, illegible copy, default-looking black outlines, or unexplained elements. Repetition, spacing, and palette use should feel systematic.
desired_output.editability: All artwork remains native vector geometry or editable artistic text in the CDR file.

hard_gates: CDR and PDF files are non-empty
